entry.title: Awesome Gemini Cli Updates on Oct 26 - Nov 01, 2026
entry.content:
Interfaces

  • Alchemist Coder (⭐5) - Open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that indexes your Gemini CLI chats, together with Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build sessions, into one local, read-only full-text search. Running Gemini CLI over ACP inside the app is planned for its upcoming Pro edition; the free edition runs Claude Code and Codex on local models.
  • SwarmPane - Desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI (with a Gemini API key) side by side with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent, Copilot, Devin and more, up to 16 at once in real terminals, with a git worktree per agent, undo for every agent step and account switching when a usage limit hits. Paid, with a 7-day trial for $1.

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • AutoHarness (⭐3) - Makes Gemini CLI (and Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code) prepare before it builds: splits the task into areas of know-how, finds or writes a skill for each, checks the result against the original, and lets a fresh critic judge it. MIT.
  • Concord MCP (⭐608) - Local-first shared work-state MCP server (npx -y @concord-ai/concord-mcp) that lets coding agents coordinate on one repo through presence, file claims, messaging, handoffs and review packets. Works with Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. TypeScript, stdio, MIT.
  • LitGravity (⭐166) - Adds lit to the Antigravity CLI (agy) so a request is planned, built with tests and recorded checks, reviewed, and closed with a handoff note.

Commands & Extensions

  • Gemini Safety Net (⭐3) - Gemini CLI extension that runs cc-safety-net (⭐1.7k) as a BeforeTool hook. It blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands, and reads of secrets such as SSH keys and .env files, before Gemini runs the tool call. It parses the command, so wrapped forms such as bash -c are also checked. It is not a sandbox. MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/kenryu42/gemini-safety-net.
  • US Watchlist Alerts (⭐2) - Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for a US stock watchlist: NYSE-aware, de-duplicated price alerts (levels, % moves, gaps, 52-week highs/lows, MA crosses, RSI, earnings) and morning/close briefs. Stdlib Python, no API key, never places trades. MIT. Install with npx skills add eli-alvarado/us-watchlist-alerts -y -a gemini-cli.
  • Dex (⭐92) - Gemini CLI extension with three Agent Skills for analytics engineering: explore a warehouse or DuckDB file read-only (profiles, PII flags, verified joins), author dbt models and semantic layers as reviewable diffs, and detect schema drift. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/exmergo/dex; needs uv.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • ChatVault (⭐24) - Windows app that reads, searches and backs up your Gemini CLI chats across accounts, and continues any chat in Gemini CLI through a handoff file that carries the whole conversation.
  • laya-guard (⭐30) - Local guardrail with a BeforeTool hook for Gemini CLI (laya-guard install gemini-cli) that judges each shell command before it runs, using regex rules, protected paths, and a small on-device model. Blocked commands are denied; ones marked for review pass with a note. Also hooks into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents. MIT.
  • ratchet (⭐3) - Code-size budget CLI (pip install ratchet-size): ratchet check refuses changes that grow source or test line counts past a ceiling, and only ratchet grant raises it. For Gemini CLI it is wired through a GEMINI.md instruction snippet (no hook); a CI check or git pre-commit hook enforces it.
  • OpenMoat (⭐2) - Local policy layer with a BeforeTool hook for Gemini CLI (openmoat init) that checks every shell command, file read and write, web request and MCP call against one policy before it runs, blocking what the policy denies. Adds an egress proxy, MCP server pinning and a hash-chained audit log, and the same policy covers Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. Rust, MIT OR Apache-2.0.

MCP Servers

  • Firecrawl - Official Firecrawl MCP server for web search, page scraping to markdown or JSON, and site crawling. The hosted server works keyless (rate limited) with search, scrape and parse; add an API key for crawl, map and the rest. The open-source server is MIT (source (⭐7.6k)). Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http firecrawl https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp.
  • npmscan (⭐2) - npm supply-chain security: checks packages for malware, known vulnerabilities, typosquats, maintainer takeovers and risky install scripts before install, and audits package.json, lockfiles, SBOMs and PR dependency changes. 23 read-only tools, no API key, no signup. Remote Streamable HTTP, bundled with 5 skills as a Gemini CLI extension. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/salemalem/npmscan-mcp-plugin.
  • deed.page - Static hosting for agents with a remote MCP server that lets Gemini CLI publish an HTML file or static folder to a permanent public https://<slug>.deed.page URL and update it with the token it gets back. No account or API key for publishing; the companion Agent Skill is MIT (source (⭐2)). Remote Streamable HTTP. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http deed-page https://deed.page/mcp.
  • ppl - Personal CRM for humans with AI agents, with a hosted remote MCP server (OAuth) at https://withppl.com/mcp: Gemini CLI can look up contacts, log interactions, keep notes and set reminders about the people in your life. Free beta up to 1,000 contacts at https://withppl.com/register.
  • Super (⭐3) - Permission-gated superuser (sysadmin) MCP server that lets Gemini CLI check system status, disks and processes, run shell commands and read GitHub, behind a dangerous-command denylist, human approval gates, optional Cisco AI Defense and Duo authorization, and an append-only audit log. Python, local stdio; pip install superuser, then add the superuser command to your Gemini CLI MCP server config.
  • Cooper Email - Email inboxes for agents with a hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server at https://cooperemail.com/mcp (OAuth or API key): Gemini CLI gets its own username@cooperemail.com address to send, read, and reply to mail and wait for replies or sign-up codes. The free plan includes 5 inboxes.
  • CodeTrendy - Search CodeTrendy, a curated directory of newly launched startups, SaaS tools and indie products, from Gemini CLI: keyword search with category and pricing filters, full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, trending listings and the site of the day. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account: gemini mcp add --transport http codetrendy https://codetrendy.com/api/mcp.
  • BlockVectra (⭐0) - MCP server for Robinhood Chain and multiple EVM networks. Connect over remote Streamable HTTP to discover chains and read docs without a key; RPC access follows each chain's policy, while Data API and account tools need an API key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/blockvectra/mcp --ref main.
  • MEDIAPRONET - Search the MEDIAPRONET launch and discovery directory from Gemini CLI: keyword search over newly launched startups, SaaS tools and online products (category and pricing filters), full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, categories and what is trending. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http mediapronet https://mediapronet.com/api/mcp.
  • LLMSlim (⭐21) - Long-term memory for Gemini CLI and other MCP clients over a local stdio MCP server. Five tools (remember, recall, list_memories, forget, fit_context): messages are stored word for word in local SQLite or your own Postgres, and recall returns the stored messages that answer a question within a token budget, with no LLM call inside. MIT. Install: pip install "llmslim[mcp]", then gemini mcp add --scope user llmslim llmslim mcp.
  • Aria Icons (⭐101) - MCP server with 12 tools for searching ~1.4M open-source SVG icons and adding them as SVG or React/Vue/Svelte/Solid components; remote endpoint needs no auth. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http aria-icons https://icons.leularia.com/api/mcp.

Documentation & Examples

  • MCP servers, harness by harness (RigFit) - One MCP server (Context7) configured in Gemini CLI's settings.json alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode and goose, using each tool's documented syntax, with sources dated.

entry.title: Awesome Gemini Cli Updates on Oct 19 - Oct 25, 2026
entry.content:
Interfaces

  • Yaw - Cross-platform terminal that auto-detects Gemini CLI and opens a split-pane workflow with a companion terminal.
  • Termly - Free native iOS and Android app to monitor and control Gemini CLI (and other CLI AI assistants) remotely. Zero-knowledge E2E encryption, pairs in under 60 seconds via QR code. No subscriptions, no usage limits.
  • AnywhereDesign - Local-first voice cockpit and remote mobile interface for Claude Code & Antigravity/Gemini CLI. Control terminal agent sessions from your phone via local QR code, real-time voice dictation, live terminal output streaming, and zero-token mobile Git sync.
  • Mobile SSH - Android and iOS (TestFlight beta) SSH client for running Gemini CLI on remote servers, with a Gemini CLI installer plugin, simultaneous terminal sessions, and tmux session management.
  • Bellows - Desktop workspace that runs Gemini CLI over ACP alongside Claude and Codex, with diffs, permission prompts, team rules, a hash-linked audit trail and live session sharing. Windows, macOS and Linux.

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • Tars - A local-first autonomous supervisor and sidekick powered by Google Gemini. Features background persistence (heartbeat), tiered local memory, multi-channel notifications (Discord/WhatsApp), and self-healing background services. Designed for reliable, long-running agentic orchestration in the terminal.
  • VibeFuse - Free Windows desktop harness that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Qwen as live draggable widgets on one canvas, with named sessions, local Whisper/Piper voice, an MCP tool panel, and a marketplace where skill and widget sellers keep 80% (Stripe Connect).
  • Drevon - Mac app that connects to your Claude Code or Codex and turns it into an end-to-end GTM operator: research, grunt work, analysis and actions across your stack from a single prompt, in your own browser with your own logins.
  • magents (⭐14) - Gemini CLI extension, MCP server and CLI over the session transcripts Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Grok and OpenCode already write. List and read other live sessions, hand off compact state, send into a specific chat, or spawn a headless session that replies through a shared inbox. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/abnegate/magents. Rust, MIT.
  • SpaceApp (⭐14) - Self-hosted web workspace that runs Gemini CLI alongside OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code and other coding CLIs as side-by-side panes in persistent rooms, with MCP servers and managed browser panes. Install: npx --yes run-spaceapp@latest install. Source-available (BSL 1.1).

Commands & Extensions

  • brethof-brain (⭐1) - Gemini CLI extension for the hosted brethof-brain memory: with every prompt, the records that bear on it arrive before Gemini answers; a brief at session start; every turn archived; the same memory is shared with Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Needs a brethof-brain account (free plan). Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/BrethofAI/brethof-brain-client.
  • PostEverywhere (⭐0) - Social media scheduler for Gemini CLI. Write, schedule and publish posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest and Bluesky, and plan a content calendar. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/posteverywhere/gemini-cli-extension (posteverywhere.ai).
  • MoltNode by Chord (⭐0) - Gemini CLI extension that connects two hosted MCP servers and a GEMINI.md context file: MoltNode for JSON-RPC reads on 31 blockchains, and Chord for DEX swap quotes and unsigned swap transactions on Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Arc, plus token boards, candles and wallet PnL. No API key; the agent's own wallet signs every transaction. MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp.
  • Thinking Methods (⭐15) - Curated Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for structured thinking on real decisions: five whys, pre-mortem, trade-offs, prioritization, six thinking hats, and twelve more methods plus a selector skill. Install as a Gemini extension (gemini extensions install https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills) or skills only (gemini skills install https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills.git --path skills). MIT.
  • Kuudo Skills (⭐2) - Gemini CLI extension with 22 Agent Skills for Amazon sellers and advertisers: Sponsored Products and Brands audits, search-term mining, budget pacing, DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud, listings, product images, repricing, FBA inbound, and profitability, built for Kuudo's hosted Amazon Ads and SP-API MCP servers. Price, budget, listing, and shipment writes are previewed and wait for your approval. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/KuudoAI/skills. PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 (source-available).

Development Tools & Utilities

  • IssueDB - LLM frendly command-line issue tracking system for software development projects, with built-in interface, context support and prompt providers for Gemini CLI and others.
  • MCP Config Doctor - Browser-local diagnostic that validates Gemini CLI ~/.gemini/settings.json MCP server entries (shape, env/secret references, transport fields). Also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI, and VS Code MCP configs. No account, no telemetry, no remote calls — runs entirely in the browser.
  • Usage HUD - Native macOS menu-bar meter that shows your Gemini CLI usage window next to Claude, Codex, Grok and Ollama, with a confidence label on every number. Paid, $9.
  • Agent Cat - Free macOS/Windows menu-bar app that shows Gemini CLI and Antigravity usage and limits next to Claude Code and Codex, read from local files.
  • Awakado - macOS menu-bar app that keeps the Mac awake while Gemini CLI is working, using Gemini CLI hooks, and lets it sleep when it finishes. Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.
  • SkillKeeper - macOS menu bar app that reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions to show which skills, agents, MCP servers and tools ran, how often, and what they cost in tokens. Native Swift, free to track.
  • MacMD Viewer - Read-only Markdown viewer for macOS 14+ for the GEMINI.md and plan files Gemini CLI writes. Renders Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code, reloads when the file changes on disk, and adds Quick Look previews in Finder. Paid, $19.99 one-time.
  • Check (⭐0) - Extension with a BeforeTool hook that checks each file write on your own machine before Gemini CLI makes it (and, on Linux, each shell command): files, folders, programs, git refs and packages it names must exist, and scripts must parse; what the machine proves wrong is blocked with the machine's message. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/golproductions/check-gemini. Paid, 14-day free trial.
  • tokenreceipt (⭐1) - Local CLI that reads Gemini CLI chat logs (plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agents) and prints a till-style receipt of tokens per agent and model, priced at public API list prices. Exports SVG/PNG cards or JSON; no account, no upload, no dependencies. MIT. Run: npx github:henrikdukefoss/tokenreceipt.
  • Wardlume - Locks the Mac's keyboard, mouse, and trackpad while Gemini CLI runs unattended, so progress stays visible but nobody can type into the session. Unlocks with Touch ID or Apple Watch; sandboxed with no network access.
  • session-handoff-kit (⭐0) - Agent Skill (open SKILL.md standard; installs into Gemini CLI with npx skills add alapha888/session-handoff-kit --agent gemini-cli) that ends a session with a structured handoff — goal state, decisions, files touched, open loops, next action — so the next session starts from facts instead of an over-full context. Also includes a context-hygiene checklist and a fill-in handoff template. MIT.
  • agy-powerline (⭐15) - Fast, configurable statusline for Antigravity CLI (agy), the successor to Gemini CLI, with real-time 5h/7d Gemini quota meters, pace markers, context usage, and interactive TUI editor. Zero dependencies, MIT.
  • agentvcr (⭐2) - Turns a Gemini CLI chat from ~/.gemini/tmp/*/chats (the JSONL format with rewinds and patches, or the older JSON files) into a self-contained HTML replay with a scrubbable timeline, diffs and terminal output, with API keys and other secrets masked locally first. Share it as a link through a secret gist on your own GitHub, embed it, export a Markdown transcript for a pull request, or have its GitHub Action comment the replay on agent PRs. Also reads Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode. MIT, no dependencies. Run: npx agentvcr-cli.
  • SafetyCard (⭐3) - Safety-check MCP servers and AI agents against the OWASP agentic Top 10, and get the safest setup to run them. Install with npx skills add safetycard/safetycard --agent gemini-cli.

API Bridges & Proxies

  • TeamoRouter - Hosted LLM gateway — managed alternative to self-hosted bridges. OpenAI-compatible and native Anthropic endpoints behind one API key; works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex directly. Free permanent DeepSeek tiers (V4 Pro 200 req/day, V4 Flash 50 req/day, 1M ctx).

MCP Servers

  • TWZRD Agent Intel - Trust scoring and identity verification for AI agent wallets on Solana. Verify agent identity before x402 micropayments or agent-initiated operations. Free: score_agent, preflight_check. Paid (x402): get_trust_receipt. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI.
  • AISO Tools MCP - Query a catalog of 1,636 AI tools from the CLI: keyword/category/pricing search, side-by-side comparison, and alternatives lookup, with a canonical citation URL on every result. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http aisotools https://aisotools.com/api/mcp.
  • ContextStream - Shared project context for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Grok. Intelligence isn’t the bottleneck. Context is. Remote MCP for Gemini CLI and other coding agents: https://mcp.contextstream.io/mcp.
  • SkillAgent - Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth) for searching ~3,500 agent skills, rules files (including Gemini rules) and MCP servers indexed hourly from GitHub, with project-based recommendations and per-agent install instructions for Gemini CLI. Install: gemini mcp add --transport http skillagent https://skillagent.dev/mcp.
  • LogNorm - Hosted remote MCP server that hands a website's SEO and AI-visibility (GEO) backlog (site audits, fixes, content drafts, AI-answer tracking) to coding agents. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key; free plan available. Source: lognorm/lognorm-mcp (⭐2). Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http lognorm https://lognorm.com/api/mcp.
  • LinkMCP - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts and comments, connection requests, and work email finding. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; the server is closed source. Paid plans from $19/month, 7-day free trial without a card. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/linkmcp-io/linkmcp.
  • FXMacroData - Official macroeconomic releases, central bank decisions, release calendars, FX rates and COT positioning for 22 currencies, with release timestamps and source links. Remote Streamable HTTP server; USD releases (last 90 days, 15-minute delay), the USD calendar and the USD catalogue work with no sign-in or API key, other currencies and FX rates need a key. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http fxmacrodata https://mcp.fxmacrodata.com.
  • Blawgy (⭐2) - Run your SEO blog from Gemini CLI. Research keywords, manage the content plan, write and update SEO blog posts with images and internal links, publish them to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Framer, Ghost and Duda, and read Search Console traffic, rankings and indexing status. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source, included on every paid plan with a free trial. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http blawgy https://app.blawgy.com/mcp.
  • DropTheHassle (⭐2) - Lets Gemini CLI publish the site it built on a real HTTPS link instead of localhost: a free link, no account needed. For your own .com it hands the human a €19/$19-a-year payment link; after payment the site goes live on it with no DNS. No tool spends money. For claimed sites, ask it for visitors, leads or site status. Remote Streamable HTTP, no sign-in for the first publish, or local stdio via npx -y dropthehassle-mcp. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http dropthehassle https://dropthehassle.com/mcp.
  • LinkedNav - Hosted MCP server for LinkedIn outreach in your own LinkedNav account: find leads, launch campaigns, send, and reply. LinkedNav detects LinkedIn buying signals and sends personalized outreach you approve. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source. Free 7-day trial. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http linkednav https://mcp.linkednav.com/.
  • HeyReagent - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: read your inbox, send messages and invitations, search people, and work with posts. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no key to paste; the server is closed source. Free plan available. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http heyreagent https://api.heyreagent.com/mcp.
  • SolidPing (⭐17) - Uptime and synthetic monitoring with a remote MCP server (OAuth) to create, run and diagnose checks. Works with Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http solidping https://solidping.io/api/v1/mcp.
  • Latchkey - Self-healing GitHub Actions runners with a hosted MCP server for coding agents: read the CI failures self-heal could not fix (root cause, failing file, logs), check run status, dispatch workflows, and run commands on fresh ephemeral runners. Remote Streamable HTTP with a Latchkey API key; the server is closed source. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http latchkey https://latchkey.dev/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $LATCHKEY_TOKEN".
  • Aident Loadout - Hosted MCP server that gives Gemini CLI and other MCP clients one reusable setup for apps like GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Linear and Notion, plus 400+ expert-built Skills and built-in services (search, scraping, media generation) billed from one balance. Accounts are connected once in the browser and kept in Aident Vault, and every action is logged in Audit. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; free pay-as-you-go start. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http aident https://loadout.aident.ai/mcp.
  • CurlShot - Screenshot API with a hosted MCP server: take_screenshot renders any web page in a real browser and returns the image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF; full page, device presets, ad and cookie-banner blocking), so Gemini CLI can see a page, and list_devices lists the presets. Remote Streamable HTTP with a CurlShot API key; the server is closed source. Free plan of 100 screenshots a month, no card. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http curlshot https://curlshot.com/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $CURLSHOT_API_KEY".
  • Pethost - Hosting for Docker Compose projects with a remote MCP server (OAuth): Gemini CLI deploys a project, reads its logs and HTTP traffic, and rolls it back. Add it with gemini mcp add --transport http pethost https://mcp.pethost.dev/mcp.
  • DC Hub (⭐3) - Live data for data-center site selection: a daily Data Center Power Index (DCPI) of where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets, live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs, plus fiber, gas and electricity prices. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line. 94 tools, remote Streamable HTTP, free tier needs no key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/azmartone67/dchub-mcp-server.
  • Google Hotels MCP (⭐1) - Search Google Hotels and Google Vacation Rentals from Gemini CLI: per-OTA nightly rates (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Vrbo, Airbnb, Hotels.com and 10+ other providers), 3-month daily price calendars, amenities, nearby places and review topics. Local stdio server (3 tools) wrapping Apify Google Hotels actors; uvx --from "git+https://github.com/huynhtanan/google-hotels-mcp.git@v0.1.2" google-hotels-mcp.
  • AltoRank - Open-source SEO content software with a hosted MCP server: check whether search engines and AI crawlers can read a site, research keywords, read Google Search Console, and write sourced drafts into a person's review queue. No approve or publish tool. AGPL-3.0 and self-hostable (source (⭐3)). Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http altorank https://app.altorank.co/api/mcp.

Documentation & Examples

  • Gemini CLI limits & pricing (QuotaBurn) - Source-linked guide to Gemini CLI daily request quotas, the free-tier change, and per-token API cost.

entry.title: Awesome Gemini Cli Updates on Oct 12 - Oct 18, 2026
entry.content:
Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • puenteo (⭐1) - Gemini CLI extension + MCP server that lets Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions on one machine search each other's history and message each other live (send/wait/reply, channels, file claims). Local SQLite, no daemon.
  • Mudroom (⭐11) - Runs Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Aider and opencode inside a Linux micro-VM on a copy-on-write clone of your project, with a network allowlist and a pull-request-style diff review before changes are applied.
  • DHI Orbit (⭐1) - Local web dashboard that lists Gemini CLI and Antigravity chats alongside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on one board, with what needs an answer and a reply box (gemini --resume <id> -p). Python standard library only, MIT.
  • Crewly (⭐89) - MIT-licensed, local platform that runs a team of role-based agents (developer, QA, PM, orchestrator) on Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex, with task delegation through agent skills, shared persistent memory, and a web dashboard of live agent terminals. Requires one of these agent CLIs installed and logged in.

Commands & Extensions

  • Supercov (⭐156) - Coverage, security and code quality for coding agents. Gemini CLI extension that runs the project's existing tests, measures line, branch and MC/DC coverage, and hands Gemini the untested code to test next. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov.
  • figma-maxxing (⭐11) - Gemini CLI extension with 8 skills for agents editing real Figma files: Plugin API gotchas, checks before and after every write, comments to verified fixes, and a handoff gate. Built on figma-console-mcp; 3 of the checks also ran once on Figma's official MCP server. MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/thiagoxikota/figma-maxxing.
  • NotWorking (⭐2) - Downdetector for AI agents: a skill and remote MCP server that checks whether other agents report the same site, skill or MCP server failure, and takes failure reports. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/RyanNSJ/notworking.
  • assay (⭐108) - Deterministic QA for web pages, with a Gemini CLI skill. assay opens the page in Chromium with Playwright, drives every control, and reports where the page contradicts itself, with no LLM and the same result on every run. The skill tells Gemini CLI to run assay after it changes a page and report what it found. Install with pip install assay-ui, then add the skill file. MIT.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • fakegreen (⭐4) - Deterministic diff checker with an AfterAgent hook (npx fakegreen install gemini) that denies the turn when the agent skipped or deleted tests, weakened assertions, added suppressions, special-cased the test environment or forced CI green with || true, and feeds the findings back so Gemini fixes them. No LLM or API key. MIT.
  • yoink (⭐5) - Saves and switches Gemini CLI Google logins (oauth_creds.json and google_accounts.json) alongside Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code and GitHub Copilot logins, from a CLI or a macOS menu bar app.
  • aisw (⭐135) - Saves Gemini CLI logins and API keys as named profiles and switches the live ~/.gemini state in one command, alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI. Docs: aiswitcher.dev.
  • LynxPrompt (⭐54) - Self-hosted web app that turns one set of AI coding rules into the file each tool reads: Gemini CLI's GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules and Copilot instructions, 30 rule-file formats in all. Blueprints carry variables so a team shares one set across projects, and the lynxp CLI writes the files into each repository. AGPL-3.0.
